verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair question for a state regulator and business registry, so the axis applies. The pack holds only robots.txt probes: both SCC hosts disallow all crawling, so nothing was fetched and no bulk download, dataset or registry extract is documented. The Virginia Tax probe concerns a different agency and is not about this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
